body: before breakfast: the crop trial crew brought rinsed gloves. my brother started coughing. I washed everything twice before the buses quit running.
title: Before breakfast: rinsed gloves

body:
The woman at the next table asked why they were taking names with the breakfast order. I told her it was probably for the bill. The waitress folded the list and put it in her apron, though we had all paid at the counter.

Later a man came in through the kitchen, spoke to her, and left with the folded paper. Nobody cleared our plates while he was there. I kept looking at the clock because my sister was due to meet me.

She never arrived. I wrote down the time, then crossed it out when I realized I couldn't remember whether the clock had stopped before or after the man came in. The waitress set a fresh pot on the stove and kept serving everyone else.
title: Names with breakfast
